description:
Hazelnut Gelato in the Ninja Creami – Ultra Smooth & Easy

Rich, nutty, and incredibly smooth — this hazelnut gelato made in the Ninja Creami is one of the easiest ways to create authentic gelato at home. Using hazelnut extract and a balanced base, this recipe delivers deep flavour and a silky texture without needing professional gelato equipment.

In this video I walk through how to make a proper hazelnut gelato base, freeze it, and then spin it in the Ninja Creami to get that signature creamy gelato texture. If you love gianduja, Nutella, or roasted hazelnuts, this one is going to become a favourite.

I also show you how to make delicious hasenut praline to serve at the same time, the combo is simply DEVINE.

This method also avoids icy textures and gives you a perfect scoop straight from the Creami.

⸻

Timestamps

00:00 Introduction and the extract
01:18 Ingredients
02:59 Making the gelato base
04:27 The Praline
06:09 Spinning in the Ninja Creami
07:07 Reveal and taste
08:29 Fixing split pralin
09:17 Outro 

⸻

Ingredients:

567 g Cream, half and half 10% fat
46 g Skim milk powder
5 g Hazelnut extract
124 g Granulated sugar
4 g Guar gum
5 g Sunflower lecithin

The Praline:

100g hazelnuts
100g sugar (75g will do too)

⸻

Equipment Used

• Ninja Creami
• Blender
• Freezer-safe Creami pint container

⸻

If you enjoy food science, chocolate work, and professional dessert techniques, subscribe for more recipes and experiments.

⸻
